run_accept_prefix: run the accept script in prefix mode to check if a string is a valid grammar prefix
run_accept_sentence: run the accept script in sentence mode to validate a complete sentence against an EBNF grammar
parse_ebnf_grammar: parse an EBNF grammar file and build a StringRecognizer to validate input strings
review_main_function: review the main function that reads a grammar file and checks sentence acceptance
test_string_recognizer: test the StringRecognizer class to validate whether a sentence matches the parsed grammar
